title: Chunking verdicts under count- and budget-matched retrieval: code, pre-registrations and results
description:
Code, pre-registrations, deviation logs, run manifests and per-query results for a pre-registered multiverse analysis of how the retrieval-selection protocol (a fixed number of chunks vs a fixed word budget) changes chunking verdicts in retrieval-augmented generation. Includes an extension to semantic chunking and dense retrieval (bge-m3), an exploratory answer-quality check (Qwen3-4B) and a provisional protocol audit of recent chunking studies.

Code is MIT-licensed; results, documents and figures are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). The four source datasets are not redistributed; they are downloaded and hash-checked by the included fetch script.
notes: Results, documents and figures: CC BY 4.0. Gold answer strings from SQuAD 2.0, COVID-QA, CUAD and Qasper remain under those datasets' licences.
